function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve the list of nodes for a specified network fabric. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The endpoint URL to which the GET request is sent. It must follow the format: 'https://{ip}/insightsGroup/{insightsGroup}/integration/{integrationName}/integrationData?epochUUID={epochUUID}', where placeholders are replaced with actual values.

params.description: Additional parameters to be sent with the GET request as a query string. If not provided, no additional parameters are included in the request.

epochUUID.description: A unique identifier for the epoch. This UUID is used to fetch data pertaining to a specific time frame.
